obs.// host: obs-websocket address. Tools > WebSocket Server Settings in OBS.
obs.// password: Can also be supplied via the OBS_PASSWORD environment variable, which keeps it out of this file.

video.// mode: How the preview reaches this binary:
video.// builtin: OBS Stream -> WHIP. Lowest latency and fewest moving parts, but it uses up the single Stream output.
video.// mpegts: OBS Recording -> MPEG-TS over UDP. Leaves the Stream output free for YouTube. H264 + Opus are forwarded without transcoding.
video.// external: An already-running MediaMTX or similar serves WHEP.
video.// streamPath: Path segment the preview is published and played on.
video.// tsListen: mode=mpegts only. Point OBS's Recording custom FFmpeg output at udp://127.0.0.1:9000?pkt_size=1316 with container 'mpegts' and audio encoder 'libopus' (browsers cannot decode AAC over WebRTC).
video.// whipUrl: mode=builtin only. Point OBS's WHIP stream service at http://127.0.0.1:8080/preview/whip
video.// externalWhepUrl: mode=external only. Blank derives it from the request host and externalPort.

ptz.// enabled: Set true on the machine that has obs-ptz plus PTZ hardware.
ptz.// deviceId: Which camera in the obs-ptz dock to drive. 0 = first configured camera.
ptz.// speeds: Maximum pan/tilt/zoom rate at full joystick deflection, 0.0-1.0. Lower these if the camera overshoots when framing.
ptz.// profile: Maps abstract ops onto obs-ptz vendor requests, taken from the plugin's own signatures:
ptz.// sig1: void ptz_move_continuous(int device_id, float pan, float tilt, float zoom, float focus)
